newsitem.title: BULGARIA: YIELD FLAT ON BULGARIA 1-WK T-BILLS, FALLS ON 4-WK.
newsitem.headline: YIELD FLAT ON BULGARIA 1-WK T-BILLS, FALLS ON 4-WK.

text.p: Yield was unchanged at Tuesday's
auction of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week discount
T-bills but fell on four-week discount T-bills, central bank
figures showed.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 1.58
and 5.32 percent, respectively against 1.58 percent and 5.40
percent on Monday.
Bids were received for a total of 35.102 billion levs of
T-bills for today's auctions and the ministry approved all the
bids.
The issues were offered with par values of 20 billion levs
and 45 billion levs, respectively and no minimum acceptable
prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
